capabilities: Build a single-page dashboard from memo, todo, project, folder, library, calendar, query, web, RSS and media sections
Capture memos and todos with subtasks, reminders, progress tracking and one-click archiving
Run built-in Dataview-style queries and aggregate dated tasks into month and week calendar views
Browse, batch-organize and drag-to-import vault media in a material library
Add sidebar widgets for pomodoro, habits, reading, expenses, weather, countdowns and more
extras: All dashboard data lives in a plain dashboard.md file; deleting, renaming or reordering sections requires editing that file by hand. Ships 11 interface languages and 13 themes; weather uses Open-Meteo with no API key; companion Apex Clipper Chrome extension clips web content into the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in home page, so memos, tasks, projects, files and everyday tools stay scattered across many notes and plugins.

relations.evidence: No separate Dataview plugin is needed.
